actions.description: Each action, in the one-line form the text output uses.

name.description: The hook's name, or `null` when unnamed.

when.description: Its `when`, or the empty string when it fires every add.

choices.description: The values a `choice` slot accepts, or `null`.

env.description: The environment variable the slot reads, or `null`.

kind.description: Its value kind, such as `string` or `choice`.

prompt.description: The prompt the editor and `--describe` show, or `null`.

required.description: Whether a value must be supplied when no default is present.

description: The object `mt add --describe=json` prints: the template's slots, each with its kind, default and choices, and the project's `[[on.add]]` hooks.

$schema.description: The URL of the schema this object conforms to.

hooks.description: The project's `[[on.add]]` hooks, in merged order.

slots.description: The template's slots, in declaration order.

title: Mindtape template slots and add hooks
